verdict.rationale: The Texas Comptroller is a state tax authority. Its core product is the government's own filing and payment service (Webfile/eSystems), which only the agency can operate, so self-hosting is a category error for this kind of product. The open-data rail (keyless Socrata JSON on data.texas.gov) is a read-only dataset feed, not a self-hostable deployment of the core product, and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
